WATERFRONT LEAD: lakeview -> not waterfront. Esri z18 at 41.0446,-95.7380: pad rows are west of Lake Drive, about 90 m from the lake's edge, and the lake sits behind a raised embankment that carries the road and trail. Open-Meteo DEM: pads 300 m, lake side points 308 and 315 m (coarse, but it says the pads are well below the pool). AWH's below-dam rule: behind a berm and below pool = no lake value. The stored note itself said 'set back across a road and vegetated buffer'. Unsure, so down. Separately, Keg Creek runs about 25-40 m west of the westernmost pads through brush, roughly 10-15 m wide; creek-size, and I can't confirm a view. Not proposed.
